description: This file contains a class CommandJsonMapper responsible for serializing and deserializing command objects to and from JSON representations. It leverages Jackson's ObjectMapper for conversions and uses a class attribute to include type information.

classes.name: CommandJsonMapper
classes.description: A Spring-managed component that provides methods to serialize command objects to JSON and deserialize JSON to command objects, embedding type information using a '@class' attribute.

methods.name: map(JsonNode source)
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON node into an object of the appropriate class based on the '@class' attribute.

methods.name: map(Object source)
methods.description: Serializes an object into a JSON node, including the class information in the '@class' attribute.
